references.text: Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh asked Moses for permission to settle east of the Jordan, which is the background for Joshua's speech to them.
Moses gave permission for these tribes to settle east of the Jordan on the condition that they helped the other tribes conquer the land.
Moses describes how he gave the land east of the Jordan to Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Reference to the land given as an inheritance to Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed the Jordan armed in front of the Israelites, just as they had promised.
Joshua sent Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh home after they had fulfilled their duty.
